intro: Deviate Hides is a task given by Nalpak, a disciple of Naralex stationed above the entrance to the Wailing Caverns. While Naralex lies trapped in a twisted nightmare, Nalpak seeks to salvage something useful from the mutated beasts spawned beneath the Barrens. By gathering skins from these deviate predators, he hopes to put their strange, otherworldly properties to practical use.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.
If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, friend.
